# Psalm 92 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm. A-song for-the-day-of the-Sabbath. Good to-give-thanks to-YHWH, and-to-sing-praises to-your-name O-Most-High,

**2** To-declare in-the-morning your-steadfast-love, and-your-faithfulness in-the-nights,

**3** On a-ten-stringed-instrument and-on the-harp, on-resounding-music on the-lyre.

**4** For you-have-made-me-glad O-YHWH by-your-work; at-works-of your-hands I-will-sing-for-joy.

**5** How great your-works O-YHWH! Very deep your-thoughts.

**6** A-brutish man not knows, and-a-fool not understands this:

**7** When-sprout the-wicked like-grass, and-flourish all doers-of iniquity — it-is to-be-destroyed-them forever.

**8** And-you on-high to-forever O-YHWH.

**9** For behold your-enemies O-YHWH, for behold your-enemies will-perish; will-be-scattered all doers-of iniquity.

**10** And-you-have-exalted like-a-wild-ox my-horn; I-am-anointed with-oil fresh.

**11** And-looks my-eye on-my-enemies; against-those-rising against-me the-evildoers hear my-ears.

**12** The-righteous like-a-palm-tree will-flourish; like-a-cedar in-Lebanon he-will-grow.

**13** Planted in-house-of YHWH, in-courts-of our-God they-will-flourish.

**14** Still they-will-bear-fruit in-old-age; fat and-fresh they-will-be,

**15** To-declare that upright YHWH, my-rock, and-no unrighteousness in-him.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **92:1**: The only psalm specifically designated for the Sabbath day (yom hashabbat). Jewish liturgical tradition assigns it to Sabbath worship.

- **92:12-14**: Palm tree and cedar — endurance and majesty; 'bearing fruit in old age' counters the mortality themes of Psalms 88-90.

— EMET
